policy.gate_scope: A gate on a CONTRACT blocks work that CONSUMES the contract (any coder task, anything under the go_target), not work that produces knowledge the decision needs anyway. Contract-shaped storage, Go code, and amending the gated DEC-n may not. An open gate must never mean an idle factory.

Capture LB-DEC31 has a ZERO first segment and still grades the arm by 6,015 minor units.
